Stock Time Series Data

This API returns daily time series (date, daily open, daily high, daily low, daily close, daily volume) of the global equity specified.

API Parameters

Parameter Required Description
function Yes The time series of your choice
symbol Yes The name of the equity of your choice
apikey Yes Your API key

Examples

https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo

Premium endpoints available for enhanced data access.

Foreign Exchange

This API returns the realtime exchange rate for any pair of digital currency (e.g., Bitcoin) or physical currency (e.g., USD).

API Parameters

Parameter Required Description
function Yes CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_RATE
from_currency Yes The currency you would like to get the exchange rate for
to_currency Yes The destination currency for the exchange rate
